create or alter procedure [bulkload].[GetLoadColumns] @action varchar(2), @type varchar(50), @id int, @getLookups bit = 1 as begin declare @fields table (ID int identity, FieldTypeID int, Name nvarchar(250), [Required] bit, PartOfKey bit, AllowMultipleValues bit, IsLookup bit, [Level] int) declare @lookups table ([Value] uniqueidentifier, FieldTypeID int, [Label] nvarchar(max)) declare @current int = 1, @max int, @isLookup bit = 0, @fieldTypeID int
if @action = 'M' begin if @id = 0 begin insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (1, 'Action', 1, 0, 0, 1, 1) insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (0, 'Group Name', 1, 1, 0, 0, 1) insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (0, 'User Email', 1, 1, 0, 0, 1)
insert into @lookups (FieldTypeID, [Label]) values (1, 'Add') insert into @lookups (FieldTypeID, [Label]) values (1, 'Remove') end
if @id = 1 begin set @type = 'ResourceType'
insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (1, 'Status', 1, 1, 0, 0, 1) insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (0, 'User Email', 1, 1, 0, 0, 1) insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (0, 'First Name', 1, 1, 0, 0, 1) insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (0, 'Last Name', 1, 1, 0, 0, 1)
insert into @lookups (FieldTypeID, [Label]) values (1, 'Active') insert into @lookups (FieldTypeID, [Label]) values (1, 'Inactive') end end
if @action = 'O' begin insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (1, 'Responsibility', 1, 1, 0, 1, 1)
insert into @lookups (FieldTypeID, [Label]) select 1, Name from ResponsibilityType order by Name
insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (2, 'Resource', 1, 1, 0, 1, 1)
insert into @lookups (FieldTypeID, [Label]) select 2, 'User:' + email from reporting.Global_Resource order by email
insert into @lookups (FieldTypeID, [Label]) select 2, 'Group:' + DisplayValue from AssetDetail A where A.Object = 'Group' order by DisplayValue
insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (0, 'Asset UID', 1, 1, 0, 0, 1); end
if @action = 'P' begin if @type = 'IntersectType' begin declare @s varchar(50), @sid int, @o varchar(50), @oid int
select @s = Subject, @sid = SubjectID, @o = Object, @oid = ObjectID from IntersectType where ID = @id
if @s = 'TaxonomyType' begin insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (0, 'Subject Path', 1, 1, 0, 0, 1) end else begin insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) select FT.ID, 'Subject ' + FT.Name, FT.IsRequired, FT.IsPartOfKey, FT.AllowMultipleValues, case FT.Type when 'Lookup' then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end as IsLookup, 1 from FieldType FT where FT.IsPartOfKey = 1 and FT.Object = @s and FT.ObjectID = @sid end
if @s = 'TaxonomyType' begin insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (0, 'Object Path', 1, 1, 0, 0, 1) end else begin insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) select FT.ID, 'Object ' + FT.Name, FT.IsRequired, FT.IsPartOfKey, FT.AllowMultipleValues, case FT.Type when 'Lookup' then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end as IsLookup, 1 from FieldType FT where FT.IsPartOfKey = 1 and FT.Object = @o and FT.ObjectID = @oid end
end
if @type = 'ArtifactType' or @type = 'ReferenceItemType' begin declare @parentTypeID int = null, @parentTypeName nvarchar(250) = null
select @parentTypeID = I.SubjectID, @parentTypeName = I.SubjectName from IntersectTypeDetail I where I.[PredicateType] = 3 and [Object] = @type and ObjectID = @id;
if @parentTypeID is not null begin insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values(0, @parentTypeName, 1, 1, 0, 1, 1);
if @type = 'ArtifactType' begin insert into @lookups ([Value], FieldTypeID, [Label]) select [uid], 0, DisplayValue from AssetDetail where typeid = @parentTypeID and [object] = 'Artifact' order by DisplayValue; end
if @type = 'ReferenceItemType' begin insert into @lookups ([Value], FieldTypeID, [Label]) select [uid], 0, DisplayValue from AssetDetail where typeid = @parentTypeID and [object] = 'ReferenceItem' order by DisplayValue; end end end
if @type = 'ReferenceItemType' begin insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (-1, 'Code', 1, 1, 0, 0, 1) end
if @type = 'TaxonomyType' begin declare @initialDepth int = 1, @maxDepth int = 1 Select @maxDepth = HierarchyMaximumDepth from AssetType where object='TaxonomyType' and objectId = @id declare @levels table (Value int) while @initialDepth <= @maxDepth begin insert into @levels values (@initialDepth) set @initialDepth = @initialDepth + 1 end
insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) select FT.ID, case when TTL.Name is not null then TTL.Name + ' ' + FT.Name else 'Level ' + cast(L.Value as nvarchar) + ' ' + FT.Name end, FT.IsRequired, FT.IsPartOfKey, FT.AllowMultipleValues, case FT.Type when 'Lookup' then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end as IsLookup, L.Value as [Level] from @levels L inner join FieldType FT on FT.IsPartOfKey = 1 and FT.Object = @type and FT.ObjectID = @id left join AssetTypeLevel TTL on TTL.[Level] = L.Value and TTL.AssetTypeID = FT.AssetTypeID end end
if (@action = 'R' or @action = 'U') begin
print 'relate / unrelate'
declare @subjectType varchar(50), @subjectTypeName nvarchar(500), @subjectTypeID int, @objectType varchar(50), @objectTypeName nvarchar(500), @objectTypeID int select @subjectType = Subject, @subjectTypeName = SubjectName, @subjectTypeID = SubjectID, @objectTypeName = ObjectName, @objectType = Object, @objectTypeID = ObjectID from IntersectTypeDetail where ID = @id
if @objectType = 'IntersectType' begin insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (0, @objectTypeName, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1) end else if @objectType = 'ReferenceItemType' and @objectTypeID = 0 begin insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (0, @objectTypeName + ' Asset Type Uid', 1, 1, 0, 0, 1) end else begin insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (0, @objectTypeName + ' Asset Uid', 1, 1, 0, 0, 1) end
if @subjectType = 'IntersectType' begin insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (0, @subjectTypeName, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1) end else if @subjectType = 'ReferenceItemType' and @subjectTypeID = 0 begin insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (0, @subjectTypeName + ' Asset Type Uid', 1, 1, 0, 0, 1) end else begin insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (0, @subjectTypeName + ' Asset Uid', 1, 1, 0, 0, 1) end end
if ((@action = 'M' and @id = 1 ) or @action = 'R' or @action = 'P') begin insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) select ID, Name, IsRequired, IsPartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, case Type when 'Lookup' then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end as IsLookup, 1 from FieldType where Object = @type and ObjectID = @id and Type not in ('ComplexRelationLookup', 'FieldFromRelationship', 'OwnershipLookup', 'RefListRelationship', 'Tag', 'Relationship') and ( (@type = 'IntersectType' and IsPartOfKey = 0) OR (@type = 'TaxonomyType' and IsPartOfKey = 0) OR (@type <> 'TaxonomyType') ) and (IsEditable = 1 or (@action = 'P' and [Type] = 'JSON') or (IsEditable = 0 and IsRequired = 1)) order by ColumnOrder;
insert into @lookups (FieldTypeID, [Label]) select F.FieldTypeID, V.[Text] from @fields F inner join FieldType FT on FT.ID = F.FieldTypeID and F.FieldTypeID <> 0 inner join FieldLookupValue V on V.FieldTypeID = F.FieldTypeID and F.IsLookup = 1 order by F.FieldTypeID, V.[Text]; end
select Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, F.[FieldTypeId], F.[Level], ( select Value, Label from @lookups where FieldTypeID = F.FieldTypeID order by Label for json path ) as Lookups from @fields F for json path end
changeSet.rollback:
